info.title: ProofTell
info.description: ProofTell checks a phone number, an email address and an IP address, one at a time or together as a 0 to 100 risk score with a verdict and its reasons. Each check is charged from your balance; the sandbox is free.

post.description: Checks a phone number at the level you choose: Basic (free: valid or not, the formats and the country), Line type (the default: the line type and the carrier the number was allocated to), Current carrier (the carrier the number is on today and whether it was ported), Line status (whether the subscriber is on the network right now) and Fraud score (a 0 to 100 score with its risk level and the number's fraud flags). Each level includes the ones before it. Charged per check from your balance; the sandbox is free.

200.description: The phone answer: the number's fields, the blocks of the level requested and the billing fields.

default.description: An error: the body carries a stable code and a message, and on 402 the amount missing from the balance.

post.description: Verifies an email address: whether it is deliverable, the result and its reason, the flags (disposable, role account, free provider, catch-all) and a likely correction of a misspelt domain. Charged per check from your balance; a syntax error, an unknown and a soft bounce are free. The sandbox is free.

200.description: The verification result and the billing fields.

default.description: An error: the body carries a stable code and a message, and on 402 the amount missing from the balance.

post.description: Looks up an IP address: whether it is a Tor exit node, a VPN or a datacenter address, and its country, region, city and network. Charged per check from your balance; a private or reserved address is answered and free. The sandbox is free.

200.description: The address, its geography, its network, the list flags and the billing fields.

default.description: An error: the body carries a stable code and a message, and on 402 the amount missing from the balance.

post.summary: Assess the risk of an identity
post.description: Scores a phone number, an email address and an IP address together, any one of them at least: a 0 to 100 score, a verdict (allow, review or deny) against your organization's thresholds, the reasons that added to the score and each signal's own result. Charged per check from your balance for the signals that answered; the sandbox is free.

200.description: The assessment: the score, the verdict, the reasons, each signal's result and the billing fields.

default.description: An error: the body carries a stable code and a message, and on 402 the amount missing from the balance.
